review: Centreline overlays checked against enlarged street spaces, 24 September 2026. Removed provisional diagonals and back-of-plot lines that were not mapped roads. Names descriptive where source labels are indistinct.
surfacePolicy: Macadam for residential streets; clinker/earth for working lanes and paths; selected cartage/works approaches modelled with granite setts. No wood-block street identified, no modern tarmac, no electrified tram infrastructure. Assignments do not establish council adoption status.
